reviewer.summary: PART A: At 8331185/8a253b6 the medical-device pack, shared types, industry catalog, assistant, shell routing, first-run curation, apps/web, website, README and docs/legal are byte-identical to cec399f (git diff --stat empty); the only regulatory-relevant additions are the nine new docs/public-launch/*.md files and the machine-authored registers 33/34 (001) and 26/27 (002), all of which record GATE-INTENDED-USE = NOT_ESTABLISHED / REGULATORY_REVIEW = WAITING_FOR_HUMAN. The 667-hit census is dominated by software 'diagnostics'; after filtering, no diagnosis, treatment, physiological-monitoring, EEG, heart-rate, neurofeedback or neurostimulation claim exists in product code, UI, website, README or legal drafts (ABSENT). 'biometric' occurs only as Face ID/Touch ID unlock in the mobile companion. The pack stores a free-text UDI, a free-form regulatoryMetadata JSON, a boolean serialTracked flag (no serial-number field exists), a 9-state lot lifecycle including 'recalled', and an append-only trace graph; no patient field exists. AI: gateway is AI_PROPOSES_ONLY with assertNoAuthorityClaim; the governed loop's live registry is read_file/write_file with default DENIED_UNKNOWN_TOOL; the only code reading lot records for the assistant is a deterministic resolver that returns quantity/status text with 'No AI model ran' and no recommendation; no code path was found feeding md-lots/md-products to an LLM lane; industry-catalog aiSkills ('RegulatoryDocAssistant','ComplaintTriage','ClinicalSummary','CareGapFinder') are descriptors counted by industryProjection.ts and have no executor. Intended-use statement: ABSENT in code/UI/marketing; docs state none exists in any custody. Inconsistencies: (i) apps/web Legal.tsx and docs/validation/verticals/HEALTHCARE.md assert 'not a medical device' while REGULATORY-SCOPE.md and registers 33/34 say the determination is WAITING_FOR_HUMAN and the shipped desktop asar contains 0 occurrences of 'not a medical device'; (ii) REGULATORY-SCOPE.md:15 says 'lot/serial tracking' but no serial-number field exists (only a boolean flag); (iii) README's 13-family module list omits Medical Devices although the section ships in the default business sidebar; (iv) apps/web (which carries the disclaimer) is referenced by no workflow or deploy file; (v) 'Healthcare Suite' catalog descriptors ('clinical workflow', 'Clinical protocols', 'Care plan') and the medical-device catalog aiSkills are present in the shipped asar behind the preview/advanced Industry Center. CDSCO: the directive sentence is recorded verbatim as DECLARED_BY_DIRECTIVE; one HTTPS GET to https://cdsco.gov.in succeeded (HTTP 200, redirected to /opencms/opencms/en/Home/, 95,827 B) and the homepage shows a 'Guidance documents' link and the string 'Medical Devices Rules, 2017' but no 'Medical Device Software', 'SaMD' or 'July' string; the guidance page itself was not fetched and nothing is interpreted. PART B: js-yaml@4.3.0 is in the packaged desktop asar (TRANSITIVE_RUNTIME via electron-updater@6.8.9) and is called via js-yaml.load on the update feed fetched from https://neuropause033.com/updates 10 s after every packaged launch; fix 4.3.2 exists and is a semver patch within ^4.1.0; backend dist/index.js does not require js-yaml (0 requires). qs@6.15.3/body-parser@1.20.6/express@4.22.2 are backend-only: express is required 14x by dist/index.js and its default extended query parser calls qs.parse(allowPrototypes:true) on every request's query string before any rate limit; urlencoded bodies use extended:false (no qs); fixes: qs 6.16.0 is outside express 4.22.2's ~6.15.1 pin (no newer express 4.x exists; express 5.2.1 is semver-major), while body-parser 1.20.8 (qs ~6.16.0) now exists within express's ~1.20.5 range, refuting the 2026-09-06 S132 memo's 'no patched body-parser 1.x'. react-router(-dom)@6.30.6 is imported only by apps/web (5 files), absent from desktop and backend closures, has no SSR usage and only static navigation targets; fix 7.18.3 is semver-major. Recommended statuses (human decides): js-yaml OPEN (patch-level FIXED achievable); qs/express/body-parser OPEN (or ACCEPTED_RISK with recorded mitigation); react-router NOT_RUNTIME_RELEVANT for the launch artifacts and OPEN for apps/web if it is ever deployed.
